name: io.github.myths-labs/prometheus-avatar
title: Prometheus Avatar
description: Give an agent a Live2D body: speech with lip-sync, expressions, and marketplace assets.

environmentVariables.name: PROMETHEUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key (pak_...) for avatar create, speak, equip and share. Omit for read-only use.

environmentVariables.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Only needed by generate_asset. Free key at https://ai.google.dev

environmentVariables.name: PROMETHEUS_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://prometheus.mythslabs.ai
